description: This file defines the interface for handling temporary files in a C project, including functions for creating, registering, deleting, renaming, and managing temporary files and directories.

classes.name: struct tempfile
classes.description: Struct representing a temporary file, including file descriptor, file pointer, filename, owner PID, and directory information.

methods.name: create_tempfile_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file at the specified path with given mode, returning a tempfile object or NULL on error.

methods.name: register_tempfile
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile for cleanup upon program exit.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_sm
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file using a filename template, with options for suffix length and mode.

methods.name: fdopen_tempfile
methods.description: Associates a stdio stream with an open tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer associated with the tempfile.

methods.name: close_tempfile_gently
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE pointer without deleting the file.

methods.name: reopen_tempfile
methods.description: Reopens a temporarily closed tempfile, truncating its contents.

methods.name: delete_tempfile
methods.description: Closes and deletes the tempfile.

methods.name: rename_tempfile
methods.description: Atomically renames the tempfile to a specified path.
